concerns.concern: Rules classify and score each edit block in isolation
concerns.why: isolateBlock-based content classification now decides which blocks are inert, so a lexer-context or neutralisation bug could hide a real change from the reviewer.

concerns.concern: Edit blocks split from hunks; hunk attention derived from blocks
concerns.why: splitHunk ranges, block ids and deriveHunk's label/attention aggregation are the new foundation every ranking step reads, and errors propagate everywhere.

concerns.concern: Model prompt scores edit blocks with surrounding context
concerns.why: Question ids, instructions, state key and truncation of the decide prompt all change, which shifts model scores and the shape the mock must answer.

concerns.concern: rankChangeSet batches, caches and merges model scores per block
concerns.why: Cache keys move from hunk ids to block ids and merging goes through mapBlocks, so the rules-bound-the-model invariant and batch counts must still hold.

concerns.concern: Result type with attempt helpers replaces try/catch in ranking
concerns.why: Rewriting error handling around batch scoring and cache save must keep the degrade-to-rules-only and ignore-save-failure behaviour exactly.

concerns.concern: Inert audit script reports per edit block
concerns.why: A read-only data check whose counts and printed lines now come from block ranges, so only its output changes.
